QuestionStmt.S: A regular polygon has 20 sides. The number of triangles that can be drawn by using the vertices but not using the sides are

Solution.S:
Total triangles = $2^0 C_3$

Triangles with two sides of the polygon = 20 (formed by 3 consecutive vertices)

Triangles with one side of the polygon = $20 \times 16$

∴ Required number of triangles

$$= 2^0 C_3 - 20 - 20 \times 16$$

$$= \frac{20 \times 19 \times 18}{1 \times 2 \times 3} - 20 - 16 \times 20$$

$$= 20(57 - 1 - 16)$$

$$= 20 \times 40$$

$$= 800$$
